hookups.source: https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/CampingSouthBay/Features.aspx ('Full hook-ups with water, electric and sewer at every site (30 and 50 amp. electric service available)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Paved RV sites, each with a grill and picnic table; tents welcome in designated areas (limited to 3 days in 60).
Two comfort stations with coin laundry, restrooms and hot showers; air-conditioned recreation room; gated entrance.

facilities.source: https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/CampingSouthBay/Features.aspx ('WiFi throughout the campground'; 'Two centrally located Comfort Stations provide coin laundry equipment, restroom, and hot shower facilities'; 'Dump station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No online booking: reserve by phone (561-992-9045, toll free 877-992-9915; office 8-4:30 daily) or email SBCamp@pbc.gov. Specific sites not guaranteed. Paid in full up to the first month; cancelling with under 24 hours' notice costs one night. Camping limited to 155 days in any 12 months.

booking.source: https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/CampingSouthBay/Reservations-Rates.aspx ('We're sorry that we are unable to provide online registration at this time ... over the telephone') + https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/CampingSouthBay/Rules-Regulations.aspx ('Reservations may be made up to 90 days prior to the arrival date'; 'Camping is limited to 155 days in any 12-month period'; 'We cannot guarantee specific campsites'), read 2026-10-21

note: Palm Beach County Parks campground at the base of the Lake Okeechobee levee in South Bay (100 Levee Rd). Boat ramp to Lake Okeechobee across the street; Okeechobee Scenic Trail atop the levee. RVs must carry an RVIA (or equivalent) seal and current registration. --Claude
summary: Palm Beach County's pages confirm 72 paved full-hookup sites (30/50-amp), showers, coin laundry, dump, Wi-Fi; booking is by phone/email only, up to 90 days ahead (platform phone and window added). Rates are not posted ('Please contact us for the most current rates'), so fees stay unknown. Note's 'Reservable online' was wrong (the county says no online registration) and dropped with the other field facts; RVIA-seal requirement added.
